newsitem.title: CANADA: Bombardier has 52 orders for new jet.
newsitem.headline: Bombardier has 52 orders for new jet.

text.p: Bombardier Inc's Bombardier Aerospace has 52 firm orders for its new Global Express long-distance executive jet, Bombardier Aerospace president and chief operating officer Robert Brown said on Monday at a press conference to launch the plane.

Laurent Beaudoin, chairman and chief executive of Bombardier said he believed the Global Express was a superior aircraft to Gulfstream Aerospace Corp's G-5. He said despite the fact that Gulfstream's G-5 program was launched a year before the Global Express program, Gulfstream has only 63 orders, of which 33 involve having to take back G-4s, the predecessor plane.
Of Bombardier's 52 firm orders, it only has to take back 10 Challengers, he said.
